"""Independent reference construction audit: CPU only, no image inference."""
import contextlib
import importlib.metadata
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys

ROOT = Path('/mnt/sdab1/userHome/wslim/.codex/worktrees/aa40/compression-gap-cl/.worktrees/ease-sizes')
SOURCE = Path('/tmp/cl-ease-official-20261007')
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
from scripts.cl_runtime import configure_environment
configure_environment()
os.environ['CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES'] = ''
os.environ['HF_HUB_OFFLINE'] = '1'
from scripts.ease_size_protocol import load_variant, canonical_pretrained_state, canonical_pretrained_digest, file_hash
from scripts.ease_reference_utils import install_reference_patches
from scripts.run_ease_reference import isolate_reference_imports, audit_variant_initialization, REFERENCE_COMMIT

import torch
import timm
torch.set_num_threads(2)
torch.set_default_dtype(torch.float32)
name, output = sys.argv[1], Path(sys.argv[2])
variant = load_variant(name)
commit = subprocess.run(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], cwd=SOURCE, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout.strip()
if commit != REFERENCE_COMMIT:
    raise RuntimeError('Read-only reference commit changed')
if subprocess.run(['git', 'status', '--porcelain'], cwd=SOURCE, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout.strip():
    raise RuntimeError('Read-only reference source changed')

isolate_reference_imports(SOURCE)
from utils import data, data_manager, inc_net
from backbone import vit_ease
from models import ease
modules = {'timm': timm, 'data': data, 'data_manager': data_manager, 'inc_net': inc_net, 'vit': vit_ease, 'ease': ease}
records = {}
config = json.loads((SOURCE / 'exps/ease_cifar.json').read_text())
config.update(device=[torch.device('cpu')], ffn_num=variant['adapter_size'])
with install_reference_patches(modules, variant['checkpoint_file'], '/mnt/sdab1/share/data', records, variant=variant):
    backbone = inc_net.get_backbone(config, pretrained=True)
    digest = audit_variant_initialization(backbone, variant)
    state = canonical_pretrained_state(backbone)
    checks = {'cpu_only': all(parameter.device.type == 'cpu' for parameter in backbone.parameters()),
              'canonical_tensor_count_150': len(state) == 150,
              'canonical_pretrained_matches_pin': digest == variant['canonical_pretrained_sha256'],
              'checkpoint_sha256_matches_pin': file_hash(variant['checkpoint_file']) == variant['checkpoint_sha256'],
              'canonical_fp32_finite': all(tensor.dtype == torch.float32 and torch.isfinite(tensor).all().item() for tensor in state.values()),
              'strict_pretrained_keys': bool(records.get('converted_checkpoint_audits')) and all(not audit['unexpected_keys']
                    and all(key.startswith('cur_adapter.') for key in audit['missing_adapter_keys'])
                    for audit in records['converted_checkpoint_audits']),
              'source_namespace_isolated': all(Path(module.__file__).resolve().is_relative_to(SOURCE)
                    for module in (data, data_manager, inc_net, vit_ease, ease)),
              'cuda_not_initialized': not torch.cuda.is_initialized()}
    report = {'variant': name, 'status': 'pass' if all(checks.values()) else 'fail', 'checks': checks,
              'reference_kind': 'author-code-size-variant', 'reference_commit': commit, 'variant_config': variant,
              'initial_canonical_pretrained_sha256': digest, 'blocks': len(backbone.blocks),
              'feature_dim': backbone.out_dim, 'num_heads': [block.attn.num_heads for block in backbone.blocks],
              'adapter_down_shapes': [list(layer.down_proj.weight.shape) for layer in backbone.cur_adapter],
              'adapter_up_shapes': [list(layer.up_proj.weight.shape) for layer in backbone.cur_adapter],
              'registered_parameters': sum(parameter.numel() for parameter in backbone.parameters()),
              'trainable_parameters': sum(parameter.numel() for parameter in backbone.parameters() if parameter.requires_grad),
              'versions': {package: importlib.metadata.version(package) for package in ('torch', 'timm', 'numpy')},
              'runtime_patches': records, 'image_forward_calls': 0, 'gpu_execution': False, 'downloads': False}
    output.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + '\n')
    if report['status'] != 'pass':
        raise RuntimeError('CPU reference construction audit failed')
print(json.dumps({'variant': name, 'status': report['status'], 'feature_dim': backbone.out_dim,
                  'adapter_size': variant['adapter_size'], 'canonical_sha256': digest}))

"""CPU feature-only audit of the author classifier block-width default."""
import datetime
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import inspect
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import sys
from unittest.mock import patch

ROOT = Path('/mnt/sdab1/userHome/wslim/.codex/worktrees/aa40/compression-gap-cl/.worktrees/ease-sizes')
SOURCE = Path('/tmp/cl-ease-official-20261007/backbone/linears.py')
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
from scripts.cl_runtime import configure_environment
configure_environment()
os.environ['CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES'] = ''
from scripts.ease_size_protocol import load_variant, VARIANTS, file_hash
from scripts.ease_reference_utils import _size_constructor
import torch
torch.set_num_threads(2)

spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('_independent_author_linears', SOURCE)
module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(module)
original = module.CosineLinear.forward_reweight
cases = []
for name in VARIANTS:
    variant = load_variant(name, verify_checkpoint=False)
    dimension = variant['feature_dim']
    specialized, specialization = _size_constructor(original, dimension)
    for task in (0, 1):
        blocks, classes, batch = task + 1, (task + 1) * 10, 8
        generator = torch.Generator().manual_seed(1993)
        features = torch.randn(batch, blocks * dimension, generator=generator)
        weights = torch.randn(classes, blocks * dimension, generator=generator)
        classifier = module.CosineLinear(blocks * dimension, classes)
        with torch.no_grad():
            classifier.weight.copy_(weights)
            classifier.sigma.fill_(1.7)
        normalized_features = torch.nn.functional.normalize(features.reshape(batch, blocks, dimension), dim=-1)
        normalized_weights = torch.nn.functional.normalize(weights.reshape(classes, blocks, dimension), dim=-1)
        cosines = torch.einsum('btd,ctd->bct', normalized_features, normalized_weights)
        coefficients = torch.full((classes, blocks), .1 / task if task else 0.)
        coefficients[torch.arange(classes), torch.arange(classes) // 10] = 1.
        expected = (cosines * coefficients[None]).sum(-1) * 1.7
        with patch.object(module.CosineLinear, 'forward_reweight', specialized), torch.no_grad():
            actual = classifier.forward_reweight(features, cur_task=task, alpha=.1, init_cls=10,
                                                 inc=10, use_init_ptm=False)['logits']
        checks = {'default_width_matches_size': inspect.signature(specialized).parameters['out_dim'].default == dimension,
                  'base_default_restored_768': inspect.signature(module.CosineLinear.forward_reweight).parameters['out_dim'].default == 768,
                  'batch_by_class_shape': tuple(actual.shape) == (batch, classes),
                  'finite_nonzero_logits': torch.isfinite(actual).all().item() and torch.count_nonzero(actual).item() > 0,
                  'independent_block_scores_match': torch.allclose(actual, expected, rtol=1e-5, atol=2e-7),
                  'cuda_not_initialized': not torch.cuda.is_initialized()}
        cases.append({'variant': name, 'task': task + 1, 'feature_dim': dimension, 'logits_shape': list(actual.shape),
                      'status': 'pass' if all(checks.values()) else 'fail', 'checks': checks,
                      'max_absolute_error': float((actual - expected).abs().max()),
                      'unique_predicted_classes': int(actual.argmax(1).unique().numel()),
                      'classifier_reweight': specialization})
output = ROOT / 'benchmarks/cl_efficiency/ease_sizes/environment/reference_cpu_initialization.json'
report = json.loads(output.read_text())
report['classifier_geometry_audit'] = {
    'completed_at_utc': datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    'scope': 'Real author CosineLinear.forward_reweight on synthetic CPU features for T1/T2 of all four variants; no images, backward, optimizer or GPU execution.',
    'status': 'pass' if all(case['status'] == 'pass' for case in cases) else 'fail',
    'source_helper_sha256': file_hash(ROOT / 'scripts/ease_reference_utils.py'),
    'audit_script_sha256': file_hash(Path(__file__)),
    'audit_script_source': Path(__file__).read_text(),
    'upstream_classifier_sha256': file_hash(SOURCE),
    'cases': cases,
    'initialization_audit_reused': 'Earlier four CPU initialization audits remain historical; the geometry correction changes only the classifier default width and leaves all ViT construction and pretrained tensors unchanged.'}
if report['classifier_geometry_audit']['status'] != 'pass':
    report['status'] = 'fail'
output.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + '\n')
print(json.dumps({'status': report['classifier_geometry_audit']['status'], 'cases': len(cases),
                  'max_absolute_error': max(case['max_absolute_error'] for case in cases), 'output': str(output)}))
if report['status'] != 'pass':
    raise RuntimeError('Reference classifier geometry CPU audit failed')
